arms.adaptive_count: stronger count baseline: in-document Witten-Bell order 4 over the TRAIN trigram base; order declared, not tuned
arms.calibrated_fixed_blend: 0.7.0 deployment recipe per-seed count weights (0.35, 0.35, 0.40), selected earlier on WikiText TUNE
arms.count: TRAIN-only order-3 alpha=0.01 counts saved in predictive_mixture/count_expert.json
arms.online_adaptive_blend: secondary: same Bayesian aggregation over neural+adaptive_count
arms.online_blend: equal-prior Bayesian aggregation over count weights k/20 of neural+TRAIN-count, vectorized scorer, posterior reset per document

protocol.document_boundaries: Each document is scored independently. Neural windows (64 inputs) and TRAIN-count history start at the document start; adaptive counts and online posteriors reset at every document.
protocol.document_rule: candidates with at least 2048 bytes; order by sha256('singularity-0.8.0-cross-domain/'+domain+'/'+name); take the declared count; keep only the first 32768 bytes

legal_prose.license: verbatim copying of each license text is permitted by its publisher
legal_prose.source: /usr/share/common-licenses license texts, symlinks resolved, duplicate contents removed

reference_prose.source: Python reference-manual topic texts in pydoc_data.topics of the build interpreter

source_code.source: top-level Python standard-library modules *.py of the build interpreter

protocol.equivalence: online_blend also scored by the 0.7.0 reference loop; max absolute per-target difference must be <= 1e-9 nats
metrics: regret versus best grid weight per document
protocol.neural_experts: three retained fixed AdamW WikiText byte transformers; no neural updates
primary_comparisons: online_blend minus neural, per domain and seed
online_blend minus calibrated_fixed_blend, per domain and seed
protocol.purpose: Prospective byte prediction comparison on documents from domains absent from WikiText training
protocol.scope: Three small frozen byte models trained on WikiText; documents from one build environment; results are conditional on these documents and do not establish behavior on other corpora or tokenizers.
protocol.test_policy: documents selected by hash rule before scoring; protocol committed before execute; one execution; no arm, document or weight changes after scores

timing.cold_start: fresh interpreter: import torch and singularity, load one checkpoint and the count JSON
timing.target: online fast median within 2x fixed blending (engineering target, reported either way)
timing.workload: seed 1000, every document separately, all domains; fixed = mix + validated loss/argmax; online fast = vectorized scorer; online reference = 0.7.0 loop

protocol.uncertainty: paired document-cluster bootstrap within each domain, seed-averaged differences, 10000 draws, rng seed 80023; descriptive
